coverage.justification: Summary A covers the headline results, year-on-year changes, loan growth, and some performance drivers, but it omits important items such as fee income, equity, capital ratios, and dividend details.

coherence.justification: The summary is clearly organized and easy to follow with no contradictions or confusing repetition.
